captionJa: 両端が閉じた円形の口部になっているメガネレンチの例。
altJa: 細長い金属製ハンドルの両端に、内側が多角形の閉じた輪状の口部を持つメガネレンチ。
purposeJa: 両口スパナの開いた口部と、メガネレンチの閉じた円形の口部を区別するための新規イラスト。

generation.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: original tool recognition illustration for a Japanese agriculture learning app. Create one single DOUBLE BOX-END WRENCH (Japanese メガネレンチ): a long steel handle with a completely CLOSED circular ring head at EACH end, each ring with a clearly recognizable polygonal 12-point inner drive opening. Both ends are rings; no open jaws anywhere. Show the entire complete wrench diagonally across the square composition, viewed mostly from above with a slight perspective revealing metal thickness and shallow offset bends. Keep both ring holes fully visible and readable, one head slightly larger than the other. Style: clean colored 2D educational product illustration, precise crisp contours, steel gray with restrained cool blue highlights and gentle shading, warm off-white plain background. Center the tool with generous margins; no cropping. No text, Japanese characters, labels, numbers, dimensions, logos, watermarks, hands, fasteners, extra tools, packaging, or demonstration of operation. This is a newly composed isolated product illustration, not a reproduction of a source photograph.
